Mites
on
amphipods

infested
0.
corniculata

killed

and

overnight

shallow

the

death
of
amphipods
in
their
burrows .
All
the

amphipods
were
found
the
next
day
to
have
no
mites .
Apparently
the
mites
react
to

the
decomposing
host
and
leave .

one

uninfested
0.

One

bore
one

the

two
mites ,

12
hours
all

transfered

amphi-

Experiments

to
discover
if
mite
transfer
could
take

place
without
close
contact
between
hosts .
Under
normal
beach
conditions
this

might

mite
movement
across

In
order
to
test
the
mites '

capacbilities
of
locomotion
in
sand ,
a
round
dish
of
beach
sand
was
prepared .

A
mite
was
introduced
at
a
marked
spot
on
the
sand ,
and
allowed
to
move
freely .

The
mite's
progress
was
observed
under
the
dissecting
microscope ,
and
it
appeared

to
have
no
great
difficulty
traveling
on
the
sand .
